note: Primary SimpleLoop run for A0. The proposal sequence lives in a file rather than in a model call: solvers.py::InjectedSolver.propose is the documented seam. Each entry is a byte copy of the named C* member, whose sha256 is re-checked against the manifest after the copy, so the script cannot smuggle in different bytes under a C* id. The sequence is chosen to exercise every verdict the study needs in one stream: a real improvement, a near-tie, an invalid candidate with the highest nominal score, an exact tie pair, and an unmeasurable candidate.
